caption: The drawing depicts a full-length, wide-skirted dress with a fitted bodice, long sleeves, and elaborate trim. The dress is shaded in a muted light greenish-blue color. The bodice is decorated with white lace at the neckline and sleeves, forming an ornate border. Three large pink bows with long ribbons accent the dress: one at the center of the neckline and two at or near the waistline. The sleeves end mid-forearm and have white lace cuffs; beneath the lace is a lining of dull red fabric visible at the edges. The skirt is voluminous, bell-shaped, and falls to the floor, with shading suggesting gathers and folds in the fabric. At the hips, the dress is further decorated with panels of white lace, creating a layered effect. In the upper right corner of the image, there is a smaller, simplified line drawing showing the back view of the dress, also with a full skirt and skirt panels, and a similar neckline and bow placement. The background of the drawing is a solid, light beige color.
title: Dress
